content: fdaconcur ptFCReg: pointwise multiple OLS at each tGrid column j — for each j, extract y_i = response[i,j] and x_{ik} = predictor_k[i,j], fit OLS with intercept to get beta0[j] and beta[k,j]. Returns beta0 (length m), beta (p×m matrix rows=predictors cols=timepoints), R2 (length m). smPtFCRegCoef then smooths beta0 and beta using local linear regression (Lwls1D) with bandwidth bw scaled as e.g. 2.5/(nGrid-1). Key fdaconcur convention: two-step (pointwise OLS → local-linear smooth), not simultaneous penalized LS.
